messages:
Mia Chen: Hey team — customer ACME reports invoice >> dashboard mismatch for their private VPC. Meter shows ~1.2M tokens in the UI but invoice charged ~1.45M. Agent id vm-meter-73 was recently upgraded. Can we triage?
Dan Rivera: Thanks, sending some logs. Can you paste the agent ledger + any heartbeat gaps? Any NTP/clock jitter noted?
Mia Chen: Quick notes: heartbeats show 1h gap around 03:10–04:10 UTC. Agent logs have a big buffering/replay burst. Snippet: 
```
2026-11-02T03:11:40Z INFO buffering 482 events to disk seq_start=345600 seq_end=345620
2026-11-02T03:12:12Z WARN heartbeat missed last=2026-11-02T02:15:12Z
2026-11-02T03:13:05Z ERROR replay failed checksum mismatch seq=345610
```
Dan Rivera: That looks like offline buffering + replay. If replayed events are accepted as new by the collector we can get double-counting. What's the agent ledger last_seq and last_replay_ack?
Mia Chen: ledger export: last_seq_seen=345680, last_replay_ack=345605. NTP: host offset ~+5s, but the meter container shows a +3m jump at 03:10.
Sasha (eng-oncall): +3 minute container clock jump is red flag. Our dedupe window currently uses ingestion_ts in the collector for some paths — if ingestion_ts moved forward during replay, duplicates may bypass dedupe. Need to confirm whether dedupe keys include seq.
Dan Rivera: Collector path note: meter-ingest currently dedupes on (agent_id, event_hash) but ingestion_ts plays into TTL. If replay preserves original client_ts but ingestion_ts is now later, some logic may not detect duplicates. I'll grep for uses of ingestion_ts.
support-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-5698 priority=P2 assigned=eng-oncall,support
Ava (billing): Customer needs a clear reconciliation. What's our estimate of duplicated tokens vs missing tokens?
Mia Chen: Preliminary calc: replayed block shows ~17k events likely duplicated; average tokens per event ~14 => ~238k tokens, which matches the ~250k delta on the invoice.
Sasha (eng-oncall): Proposed repro steps: 
1) start meter-agent in offline mode, write events to disk until seq ~345600
2) simulate container clock jump forward by >2 minutes
3) restart agent to trigger replay to collector
4) run collector with current dedupe config and observe ledger increments and ingestion duplicates
I'll run this in dev and report results.
Dan Rivera: Short-term mitigation: update collector to prefer seq-based dedupe (agent_id, seq) for replay paths; add a replay safe-window check that uses seq ranges not ingestion_ts. Long-term: ensure agent persists monotonic seq and that published replay events include an explicit replay flag.
Mia Chen: Draft customer message: "We're investigating a replay/deduplication issue in the private metering path that caused duplicate ingestion. We will reconcile and issue a corrected invoice within 48 hours." Thoughts? :+1:
Ava (billing): Approved. Include exact token delta and incident link in the follow-up.
Sasha (eng-oncall): Reproduced locally: confirmed duplicate ingestion when agent clock advanced >2m during offline buffering. Patch ready: enforce (agent_id, seq) dedupe and ignore ingestion_ts for replay events. Opening PR r/eng/collector#3456.
Dan Rivera: After PR merge: run backfill to recompute ledger deltas and a billing journal fix, then coordinate customer credit. I'll take point with finance.
Mia Chen: Thanks — attaching ledger export, logs, and token delta calc to #INC-2026-5698 and notifying customer.
support-bot: Update: #INC-2026-5698 status=investigating -> fix-in-progress
